name: Shields & Amulets
pages: Aside from the traditional weapons and armor, there are two more items to bolster your combat prowess: the {i}shield{/} and the {i}pale gold amulet{/}.

pages.text: {i}Shields{/} can, as one expects, {!}shield{/} the player from attack damage. When in your {!}main hand{/} or {!}off hand{/}, {i}shields{/} grant a passive {b}15% damage reduction{/}. When actively holding {k:use/k} to block, they will instead grant {b}80% damage reduction{/}, but have a brief cooldown between blocked attacks.{pb}{i}Shields{/}, like most gear, can be improved with a variety of {l:magic/enchantments/}enchantments{/l}.

The {i}pale gold amulet{/} is a {l:progression:netherite_age/}Netherite Age{/l} item. As such, it offers a powerful (though costly) defensive ability.{pb}When in the player's inventory, it grants the {b}absorption{/} and {b}luck{/} {l:magic/status_effects/}status effects{/l} whenever the player's health drops below 5 hearts, giving you an edge against your opponents.
